jobs.title: Director, Consulting Services - Growth and Strategy
jobs.description:
Position Description

Ready to join an organization that values innovation, inclusion, community involvement, and the opportunity to influence decisions?

CGI is more than an IT company. We combine local relationships and accountability with access to global capabilities, industry expertise, and delivery talent. CGI offers a competitive total rewards package that includes a share purchase program, profit sharing, professional development programs and flexible work arrangements.

CGI Edmonton is seeking an experienced Director, Consulting Services – Growth & Strategy to help build and scale our commercial business in the Edmonton market.

This is a leadership role focused on originating net new executive relationships, identifying client priorities, shaping differentiated consulting and technology opportunities, and closing profitable engagements that create long-term client value, recurring revenue, and future backlog.

This role is suited to a true market builder, someone who creates opportunities rather than waits for them, can open doors at the executive level, and has the commercial discipline to move opportunities from initial conversation through contract signature and successful transition to delivery.

Your future duties and responsibilities

Success in this role will be measured by the Director's ability to:

Establish meaningful executive relationships within priority Edmonton accounts.
Create qualified opportunities rather than relying primarily on inbound demand.
Convert client priorities into differentiated, commercially viable CGI solutions.
Build and maintain a credible pipeline with clear client-supported next steps.
Win new clients and expand initial engagements into long-term relationships.
Deliver signed bookings and profitable backlog that contribute to future revenue growth.
Maintain accurate forecasts and strong commercial discipline.
Mobilize CGI's broader organization effectively in a matrixed environment.

Required Qualifications To Be Successful In This Role

10 or more years of experience in complex business-to-business technology, consulting, or managed services sales, account growth, or consulting leadership.
Significant recent experience developing business within Edmonton or the broader Alberta market.
An established network of relationships within Edmonton and Alberta's commercial business community.
A proven record of building qualified pipeline and achieving or exceeding sales, bookings, or revenue objectives.
Experience engaging and influencing C-suite executives, senior business leaders, CIOs, CTOs, CFOs, and operational decision makers.
Experience positioning and selling services such as business consulting, systems integration, application development, data and AI, modernization, cybersecurity, or multi-year application management services.
Strong commercial and financial acumen, including experience with pricing, cost models, contribution margin, contracting and opportunity risk.
Strong written, verbal, presentation, facilitation and negotiation skills.
Ability to maintain a regular in-market presence with clients and the Edmonton business community.

Leadership attributes

A proactive, entrepreneurial approach to market development.
Strong consultative selling and executive relationship skills.
The ability to listen carefully, understand business problems, and translate them into actionable opportunities.
Commercial discipline and a willingness to qualify out opportunities that do not warrant investment.
Creativity in developing solutions, value propositions and paths into new accounts.
Resilience, personal accountability and comfort operating in an evolving growth environment.
The ability to influence and mobilize people without relying on direct reporting authority.
A collaborative approach that balances individual sales accountability with one team outcomes.
A commitment to client value, delivery credibility, and long-term relationships.

Education

Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Business Administration, Management Information Systems, Computer Science or a related discipline.
An equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience will also be considered (10+ years).

CGI is providing a reasonable estimate of the pay range for this role. The determination of this range includes various factors, including but not limited to skill set level, geographic market, experience and training, and licenses and certifications. Compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $110,000 - $215,000.

Why CGI

At CGI, you will have the opportunity to shape a new growth portfolio while drawing on the capabilities of a global organization. You will work with experienced leaders, consulting and technology specialists, and delivery teams to help Edmonton organizations address meaningful business priorities.

Together, as owners, let’s turn meaningful insights into action.

Life at CGI is rooted in ownership, teamwork, respect and belonging. Here, you’ll reach your full potential because…

You are invited to be an owner from day 1 as we work together to bring our Dream to life. That’s why we call ourselves CGI Partners rather than employees. We benefit from our collective success and actively shape our company’s strategy and direction.

Your work creates value. You’ll develop innovative solutions and build relationships with teammates and clients while accessing global capabilities to scale your ideas, embrace new opportunities, and benefit from expansive industry and technology expertise.

You’ll shape your career by joining a company built to grow and last. You’ll be supported by leaders who care about your health and well-being and provide you with opportunities to deepen your skills and broaden your horizons.

At CGI, we value the strength that diversity brings and are committed to fostering a workplace where everyone belongs. We collaborate with our clients to build more inclusive communities and empower all CGI partners to thrive. As an equal-opportunity employer, being able to perform your best during the recruitment process is important to us. If you require an accommodation, please inform your recruiter.

That same commitment to fairness extends to how we use technology. To support our recruitment team, AI tools may be used to help assess applications though they never replace human judgement. All hiring decisions remain entirely in the hands of our recruitment professionals.

To learn more about accessibility at CGI, contact us via email. Please note that this email is strictly for accessibility requests and cannot be used for application status inquiries.

Come join our team—one of the largest IT and business consulting services firms in the world.

jobs.title: Vice President, Client Success Strategy & Programs
jobs.description:
Opentext - The Information Company

OpenText is a global leader in information management, where innovation, creativity, and collaboration are the key components of our corporate culture. As a member of our team, you will have the opportunity to partner with the most highly regarded companies in the world, tackle complex issues, and contribute to projects that shape the future of digital transformation.

AI-First. Future-Driven. Human-Centered.

At OpenText, AI is at the heart of everything we do—powering innovation, transforming work, and empowering digital knowledge workers. We are hiring talent AI can't replace to help us shape the future of information management. Join us.

Role Overview

The Vice President, Client Success Strategy & Programs is a senior leadership role responsible for translating the Client Success Organization (CSO) strategy into an integrated portfolio of priorities, operating plans, and measurable outcomes. Reporting to the Chief Client Officer, this leader brings an enterprise-wide perspective across Professional Services, Renewals, Client Success, and Cloud Operations to strengthen alignment, eliminate duplication, improve execution, and ensure the organization is focused on the opportunities that create the greatest value for clients and the business.

The VP serves as a strategic advisor to the Chief Client Officer and CSO executive team, providing objective analysis, clear recommendations, and disciplined program leadership. The role leads business operations and program management capabilities, establishing the governance, insights, and operating rhythms required to move complex, cross-functional priorities from strategy through execution and measurable outcomes. This leader builds and leads a high-performing team of business operations, project, and program management professionals.

Key Accountabilities

Strategy & Enterprise Planning

Partner with the Chief Client Officer and CSO leadership team to shape and evolve the client success strategy in line with enterprise priorities.
Translate strategy into annual plans, investment priorities, execution roadmaps, and measurable outcomes.
Align goals across Professional Services, Renewals, Client Success, and Cloud Operations, surfacing key dependencies, trade-offs, and risks.
Bring an objective, enterprise-wide lens to planning and executive decision-making.
Guide the organizational, workforce, and capability planning needed to deliver the Client Success strategy.

Executive Partnership & Organizational Alignment

Serve as a trusted advisor to the Chief Client Officer and CSO leaders, bringing strategic perspective, sound judgment, and influence.
Translate complex information into clear executive narratives, recommendations, and decisions.
Connect teams across CSO and partner functions to clarify ownership and drive coordinated execution.
Keep client value and experience at the center of operating and investment decisions.
Represent Client Success priorities in enterprise forums and build alignment with key stakeholders.

Strategic Programs & Transformation

Lead high-impact, cross-functional CSO programs from business case development through execution, adoption, and measurable outcomes.
Ensure initiatives have clear scope, sponsorship, milestones, resources, risks, and success measures.
Provide portfolio visibility that enables timely decisions, issue resolution, and resource alignment.
Lead Client Success planning and execution for mergers, acquisitions, and divestitures, including business readiness and outcome tracking.

Business Management & Performance

Establish an integrated KPI framework that links enterprise goals, functional measures, and accountability.
Lead Client Success performance reporting for the CSO Leadership Team, Executive Leadership Team, and Board.
Use data and insights to identify performance trends, emerging risks, and efficiency opportunities.
Track delivery against strategic, financial, efficiency, and client outcomes.

Experience & Qualifications

15+ years of progressive experience in strategy, business operations, or program leadership within a complex technology organization.
Executive leadership experience, including leading multidisciplinary teams and influencing in a global, matrixed organization.
Proven success translating enterprise strategy into operating plans and measurable results.
Strong financial acumen with experience supporting planning, investment decisions, and business performance.
Strong analytical and program management capabilities, translating complex data into executive insights and disciplined execution.
Experience supporting client-facing functions such as Client Success, Professional Services, Renewals, or Revenue Operations is preferred.
M&A, divestiture, or large-scale integration and separation experience is an asset.
Bachelor’s degree in a related field; an MBA or equivalent advanced degree is considered an asset.

OpenText's commitment to diversity and inclusion surpasses legal requirements, evident in our Equal Employment Opportunity Statement of Policy which promotes a respectful and empowering environment for employees of all backgrounds, culture, national origin, race, color, gender, gender identification, sexual orientation, family status, age, veteran status, disability, religion, or other basis protected by applicable laws.

If you need assistance and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a ticket at Ask HR. Our proactive approach fosters collaboration, innovation, and personal growth, enriching OpenText's vibrant workplace.

AI Usage Disclosure:
As part of our commitment to transparency, we use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to assist in various stages of our recruitment process, including resume screening, candidate matching, interview scheduling, and communications. These tools are designed to improve efficiency, reduce bias, and enhance candidate experience. All decisions regarding hiring are made by qualified human professionals, and we continuously monitor our AI systems to ensure fairness and compliance with applicable regulations.
